high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by Kylie Jenner, as indicated by the username "kyliejenner" at the top of the image. The post was made one day prior to the screenshot being taken, as shown by the timestamp "1d." The music playing in the background is "Lana Del Rey - Art Deco," which is mentioned in the post. The setting is an outdoor balcony with a view of a building that has a classic architectural style, featuring a sloped roof and dormer windows. The balcony has ornate black wrought iron railings, adding a touch of elegance to the scene.
